children: Shoe Station Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: SHOE) (the “Company”), a leading omnichannel retailer of footwear and accessories for the family, announced today that its Board of Directors has approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend.
The quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share will be paid on October 20, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on October 6, 2026.

Future declarations of dividends are subject to approval of the Board of Directors and will depend on the Company’s results of operations, financial condition, business conditions and other factors deemed relevant by the Board of Directors.

Shoe Station Group, Inc. is one of the nation’s largest omnichannel family footwear retailers, offering a broad assortment of dress, casual and athletic footwear for men, women and children with an emphasis on national name brands. As of September 22, 2026, the Company operated 420 stores in 35 states and Puerto Rico under its Shoe Carnival and Shoe Station banners and offers shopping at shoecarnival.com and shoestation.com. Headquartered in Fort Mill, SC, and with distribution and support operations located in Evansville, IN, Shoe Station Group, Inc. trades on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC under the symbol SHOE.
